content.default:
This page explains what cookies and similar tools this website uses, why, and how to turn them off. For how we handle personal information in general, see our Privacy Policy.

What cookies are

A cookie is a small text file a website saves in your browser. Some are needed for the site to work, some remember your choices, and some tell us how the site is used. "Similar tools" means things like your browser's local and session storage, which work the same way.

Your choice

When you first visit, a banner asks whether you accept cookies. The strictly necessary ones are always on. The rest are off until you accept, and you can change your mind at any time from the cookie settings on this site. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser; the site still works, though some things may be less smooth.

Strictly necessary

These keep the site working and remember your cookie choice. They don't track you across other sites, and they can't be switched off here.

  • Cookie consent preferences — remembers what you chose in the banner. Kept for about 30 days.
  • Site display settings — the site uses your browser's session and local storage to remember which loading animation it showed last, so it doesn't repeat. This holds no personal information and never leaves your browser.
  • Login cookies — set only for our team when they sign in to edit the site. Visitors don't get them.

Analytics

With your permission, we use Google Analytics to count visits and see which pages are read, so we can improve the site. It sets cookies such as _ga and _ga_ followed by an identifier, which last up to two years and tell visits apart without naming anyone. The information is sent to Google and stored on its servers. You can opt out through the banner, or by using Google's browser add-on at tools.google.com/dlpage/gaoptout.

Embedded video and other services

Some pages may show a video from YouTube or Vimeo. We use privacy-friendly embed addresses where we can, but if you press play, the provider may set its own cookies. Their policies apply to those. The site's files are delivered through content networks (Cloudflare, Netlify and jsDelivr), which may log technical request details such as your IP address.

Site feedback tool

While the site is being built, our team uses a feedback tool (BugHerd) to leave notes on pages. It may set a cookie in your browser.

How to manage cookies

  • On this site: use the cookie settings link on the page to change what you've allowed.
  • In your browser: every major browser lets you see, block and delete cookies. Look for "Privacy" or "Cookies" in its settings.
  • Browser settings: many browsers can also send a "Do Not Track" or Global Privacy Control signal. Check your browser's privacy settings.

Changes and contact

If we add or change a cookie, we will update this page and its date. Questions? Reach us through the Contact page.

reading.label: How the sections open
reading.doc:
Click, as many as you like: nothing opens by itself; click a title to open it, and open as many as you want.
Click, one at a time: opening one closes the others.
Open as you scroll, stay open: each section opens when you reach it and stays open.
Open as you scroll, close the last: the section before it folds away.
All open: no rows, the whole policy shown.
The menu always opens the section it takes you to.
